reviews.text:
Camille and her amazing partner Syrinx were a fantastic discovery – they're truly the best!
Plus, we got photos every day!
I highly recommend them.

We entrusted our Australian Shepherd to Camille during our vacation.

I highly recommend Camille. She was incredibly gentle with our dog, attentive, and reassuring, sending a message and a photo every day.

A huge THANK YOU for your professionalism and kindness!

Fantastic visit! A loving mom who looked after my son, my little battle-breaker, for the day right in the heart of Lyon!

I highly recommend it!

After some bad experiences with dog sitters who were bored and didn't pay enough attention to the dogs' needs, I was very hesitant to entrust my border collie, who needs a lot of stimulation, to someone else. But what a joy it was to find Camille (and Syrinx!). 🥰 Walks, fun games, cuddles—everything is there to stimulate my Lisbon and give her a great day! 🥳 I can't speak for her, but judging by the fuss she makes over Camille in the morning, I think she likes her! 😂

I regularly leave my dog ​​for weekdays and I always pick her up happy and well-tired from her day with her friends. 😄 A trustworthy pet sitter that allows me to be away with peace of mind. I highly recommend PAWSY! …

I entrusted my dog ​​to Pawsy for a weekend and I'm delighted with the experience! Daily updates, lovely photos, and lots of attention for my 5-month-old puppy. A trustworthy dog ​​sitter, I highly recommend her!

Excellent experience with Pawsy!
Our dog spent two days with Camille and everything went perfectly. We picked him up in great shape and clearly delighted with his stay. A reliable and caring pet sitter whom we gladly recommend.

Ricky had a fantastic stay at PAWSY! He spent 15 days making lots of friends! He enjoyed wonderful walks in the forest and around town, and he was pampered while we were away! He's found a second family! Thank you, Camille! Ricky will gladly come back!!!

Camille looked after my Shiba during an extended stay, and I highly recommend her! I received regular updates and photos, which allowed me to leave with complete peace of mind. My dog ​​enjoyed lovely daily walks, playtime with other dogs, and lots of attention. A huge thank you!
